bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags are allowed. Small non-clear bags, fanny packs, and purses may be up to 6 x 8 x 3 inches. Empty dedicated hydration packs under 2.5L with no more than one additional pocket are allowed; standard backpacks with hydration bladders are not.
allowed: small non-clear bags up to 6 x 8 x 3 inches
empty dedicated hydration packs under 2.5L with no more than one additional pocket
bagPolicy.note: Festival policy can change; review the current FAQ before arrival.

parking.note: Parking information is not provided on the official website. Attendees are encouraged to use public transportation or rideshare services due to limited parking availability in the area.

rideshare.note: Use Balboa Street at 30th Avenue, beside George Washington High School, or Irving Street between 25th and 27th Avenues for rideshare pickup and drop-off.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Outside Lands varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: These accessible viewing platforms are for guests who use wheelchairs, have significant mobility disabilities, or who have difficulty standing for long periods of time.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry generally isn't allowed, and you can enter the festival gates once each day. If you must leave for an emergency and return the same day, speak with a Supervisor at any entrance or exit before leaving to be scanned out.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets bought close to the festival must be picked up in person at the Box Office in Golden Gate Park, at 25th Ave & Fulton, during its posted hours the week of the festival, with a valid government-issued ID. To let someone else pick up your wristband, add an alternate pickup name through Front Gate Tickets.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Check the festival map for the best entrance for your ticket type. The ADA Entrance and the VIP Entrance are at 36th Ave & JFK Drive, and VIP guests on the official Outside Lands Shuttle can use the south-side VIP Entrance on Martin Luther King Jr Drive, west of the South Gate. Festival gates open at 11:00 a.m.
